sequence: Rituel — dénombrer et écrire les nombres jusqu'à 9
notes: Rituel projeté, 10 à 15 min, un tour complet par nombre, pour 3 élèves (Wendy, Charlie, Tedo). 1) Une collection apparaît (formes variées, jamais deux fois la même) ; chacun compte et écrit sur son ardoise. 2) Celui qui a levé son ardoise le premier écrit le chiffre au stylet et le valide. 3) Le secret du chiffre : les objets deviennent des points, les points filent dans les coins du chiffre arabe, le chiffre se fonce et son tracé s'anime. 4) Entraînement d'écriture en trois temps, dans un ordre tiré au sort affiché à l'écran : relier au stylet les points numérotés dans l'ordre en comptant (le chiffre apparaît morceau par morceau grâce au tracé), repasser sur le chiffre dans le sens du tracé en partant du rond qui clignote (l'écran n'avance que si le stylet suit vraiment le chemin), puis l'écrire tout seul sans modèle. 5) Décomposition du même nombre, menée par celui qui avait trouvé : boîte rouge à gauche, boîte bleue à droite, billes groupées par couleur sur le fil, doigts qui se lèvent couleur par couleur avec le chiffre dessous. Décomposition validée = comptage des doigts un par un puis [3] + [4] → 7 animé, et fête de l'étoile. Étoiles et maisons conservées. Classe et période à ajuster : rituel filé sur l'année.

<title>Le rituel des nombres</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Lexend:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout : trois bandes fixes — barre des medailles en haut, scene centrale plein cadre, frise des chiffres en pied. Un seul theme assume : papier d'ecole regle Seyes, encre bleue, et le rouge reserve aux points du chiffre. */
:root{
  --paper:#EDF2FB; --card:#FFFFFF; --ink:#16284F; --ink-soft:#5B6E92; --ink-faint:#9AABC8;
  --rule:#C8D9F1; --rule-soft:#E3EBF8;
  --red:#E0342A; --gold:#E9A51C;
  --rose:#DE4199; --rouge:#D22D2D; --vert:#17964C; --bleu:#2A68CC; --orange:#E2701A; --violet:#7B4CC4;
  --mA:#D92B2B; --mB:#2A68CC;
  --font-display:'Fredoka','Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-ui:'Lexend',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --r:20px;
  --lift:0 2px 0 rgba(22,40,79,.07), 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(22,40,79,.45);
  color-scheme:light;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none !important}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0; font-family:var(--font-ui); color:var(--ink);
  background-color:var(--paper);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(42,104,204,.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(42,104,204,.055) 0 1px, transparent 1px 100%);
  background-size:100% 32px, 32px 100%;
  overflow:hidden;
}
button{font:inherit; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:0; background:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--bleu); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:6px}

#app{height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:0 clamp(12px,2vw,26px); gap:clamp(6px,1vh,14px)}

/* ---------- barre du haut ---------- */
.bar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:clamp(8px,1.4vw,18px); padding-top:clamp(8px,1.4vh,16px); flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1}
.brand b{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(17px,2.1vw,25px); letter-spacing:.2px}
.brand span{font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,12.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:3px}
.chips{display:flex; gap:clamp(6px,1vw,12px); margin-left:auto; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:flex-end; max-width:100%; min-width:0}
.chip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:var(--card); border-radius:999px;
  padding:7px 16px 7px 8px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:2px solid transparent}
.chip .pastille{width:clamp(26px,2.6vw,34px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); display:grid; place-items:center;
  color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,17px)}
.chip .who{font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,17px); color:var(--c)}
.chip .tally{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,16px)}
.chip .tally svg{width:1.1em; height:1.1em}
.chip.bump{animation:bump .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
@keyframes bump{40%{transform:scale(1.14) rotate(-2deg)}}
.classbar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,13px); color:var(--ink-soft)}
.classbar .track{width:clamp(60px,9vw,130px); height:9px; border-radius:99px; background:var(--rule-soft); overflow:hidden}
.classbar .fill{height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#F7C94B); border-radius:99px; transition:width .5s ease}
.gear{background:var(--card); box-shadow:var(--lift); border-radius:999px; padding:9px 15px; font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,14.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px}
.gear:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- scene ---------- */
.stage{flex:1; min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:clamp(6px,1.2vh,16px); position:relative}
.prompt{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; text-align:center; text-wrap:balance;
  font-size:clamp(21px,3.2vw,46px); line-height:1.1; min-height:1.2em}
.prompt em{font-style:normal; color:var(--bleu)}
.sub{font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,17.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); text-align:center; margin-top:-4px}

.boxwrap{flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; display:grid; place-items:center}
.box{position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; max-height:100%; max-width:100%; margin-inline:auto;
  background:var(--card); border-radius:26px; box-shadow:var(--lift); overflow:hidden; border:3px solid #fff}
.box::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:10px; border:2px dashed var(--rule-soft); border-radius:18px; pointer-events:none}
.field{position:absolute; inset:0}
.item{position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0); transform-origin:center;
  display:grid; place-items:center; line-height:1}
.item.in{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1); animation:pop .42s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1)}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0) rotate(-14deg)}70%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.18) rotate(4deg)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotate(0)}}
.item .glyph{font-size:var(--sz); filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(22,40,79,.16))}
.item .pip{width:var(--sz); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.45), transparent 58%), var(--pc);
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px -7px rgba(22,40,79,.6)}
.item .num{position:absolute; top:-14%; right:-14%; min-width:1.75em; height:1.75em; padding:0 .3em; border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--ink); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:calc(var(--sz)*.42);
  display:grid; place-items:center; opacity:0; transform:scale(.4); transition:opacity .2s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
.item.counted .num{opacity:1; transform:scale(1)}
.item.counted{animation:tick .45s ease}
@keyframes tick{50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.16)}}
.pack{position:absolute; border:3px dashed var(--rule); border-radius:22px; background:#F7FAFF}
.domline{position:absolute; left:12%; right:12%; top:50%; border-top:4px dashed var(--rule)}
.hands{position:absolute; inset:6% 4%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3%}
.hands svg{height:100%; width:auto; max-width:46%}

.cover{position:absolute; inset:0; background:
   repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #2A68CC 0 26px, #2F72DB 26px 52px);
  display:grid; place-items:center; color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600;
  font-size:clamp(34px,10vmin,110px); transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); z-index:3}
.cover span{display:block; animation:breathe 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes breathe{50%{transform:scale(1.14)}}
.box.open .cover{transform:translateY(-101%)}

/* ---------- cartes eleves ---------- */
.picks{display:flex; gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,20px); flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; width:100%}
.pick{min-width:0; background:var(--card); border-radius:999px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:3px solid var(--c);
  padding:clamp(5px,.8vh,9px) clamp(14px,1.7vw,24px) clamp(5px,.8vh,9px) clamp(5px,.6vw,8px);
  display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:clamp(8px,1vw,14px);
  transition:transform .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease}
.pick:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.pick .av{width:clamp(36px,4.2vw,62px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); color:#fff;
  display:grid; place-items:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,30px)}
.pick .nm{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; color:var(--c); font-size:clamp(18px,2.4vw,34px)}
.pick .hint{font-size:clamp(9px,.95vw,12.5px); color:var(--ink-faint); border:2px solid var(--rule-soft);
  border-radius:8px; padding:0 6px; font-weight:700}

/* ---------- tableau : nom + clavier ---------- */
.boardname{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; color:var(--c); font-size:clamp(24px,4.4vw,56px); line-height:1; text-align:center}
.keypad{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); gap:clamp(6px,1vw,12px); width:100%; max-width:760px}
.key{background:var(--card); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--lift); padding:clamp(6px,1.2vh,12px) 0;
  display:grid; place-items:center; transition:transform .1s ease}
.key:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.key svg{width:clamp(28px,4.4vw,62px); height:auto}
.key.no{font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vmin,15px); grid-column:span 1}
.key.no b{display:block; font-size:clamp(18px,3vmin,28px); color:var(--rouge)}

/* ---------- medaille ---------- */
.medal{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:clamp(4px,1vh,12px)}
.medal svg{width:clamp(130px,30vmin,300px); height:auto; animation:drop .9s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.5,1)}
@keyframes drop{0%{transform:translateY(-60%) rotate(-18deg); opacity:0}60%{transform:translateY(6%) rotate(6deg)}100%{transform:none; opacity:1}}
.medal .say{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,58px); color:var(--c)}
.confetti{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; z-index:5}
.conf{position:absolute; width:12px; height:16px; border-radius:3px; animation:fall linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{0%{transform:translateY(-10vh) rotate(0); opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg); opacity:.9}}

/* ---------- revelation ---------- */
/* ---------- l'ardoise numerique (stylet) ---------- */
.wframe{position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/2; max-height:100%; background:#fff; border-radius:24px;
  box-shadow:var(--lift); border:3px solid var(--rule-soft); overflow:hidden; touch-action:none}
.wframe::before{content:''; position:absolute; left:6%; right:6%; top:50%; border-top:3px dashed var(--rule-soft)}
.wframe canvas{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; touch-action:none; cursor:crosshair; display:block}
.wclear{position:absolute; right:10px; bottom:10px; background:#fff; border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px;
  padding:5px 13px; font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,13px); font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.wtag{position:absolute; left:14px; top:10px; font-size:clamp(9px,1vw,12px); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint)}
.boardgrid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr); grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:clamp(10px,1.8vw,26px); place-items:center; width:100%; flex:1; min-height:0}
.boardgrid .wframe{height:100%; width:auto; max-width:100%; aspect-ratio:3/2}
.boardgrid .keypad{align-self:center}

/* ---------- la revelation pas a pas ---------- */
.reveal{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:clamp(6px,1.3vh,16px); width:100%; flex:1; min-height:0}
.rtop{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:clamp(8px,1.4vw,18px); max-width:100%}
.rtop .minibox{width:clamp(110px,15vw,210px)}
.minibox{position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:14px; background:#F7FAFF; overflow:hidden; border:2px solid var(--rule-soft)}
.rcap{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,28px); color:var(--ink); text-wrap:balance}
.rcap b{color:var(--red)}
.rstage{flex:1; min-height:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:clamp(10px,2vw,28px); place-items:center; width:100%}
.rmodel{height:100%; min-height:0; min-width:0; display:grid; place-items:center}

/* ---------- l'entrainement d'ecriture en trois temps ---------- */
#view-trace{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:clamp(5px,1vh,12px); width:100%; flex:1; min-height:0}
.tracewrap{flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; display:grid; place-items:center}
.tracebox{position:relative; background:#fff; border-radius:26px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:3px solid var(--rule-soft); overflow:hidden}
.tracebox.win{border-color:var(--gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(233,165,28,.35), var(--lift)}
.tracebox svg{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%}
.tracebox canvas{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; touch-action:none; cursor:crosshair; display:block}
.tghost{fill:none; stroke:#C7D3E8; stroke-width:12; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.tink{fill:none; stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.tink2{fill:none; stroke:var(--tc,#2A68CC); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; opacity:.92}
.tdot circle{fill:var(--red); transition:fill .15s}
.tdot text{fill:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:9px; text-anchor:middle; dominant-baseline:central; pointer-events:none}
.tdot.lit circle{fill:var(--gold)}
.tdot.next circle{animation:dotpulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center}
@keyframes dotpulse{50%{transform:scale(1.4)}}
.tfront{fill:var(--tc,#2A68CC); transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; animation:dotpulse 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.tracebox.nope{animation:shake .45s}
.tsteps{display:flex; gap:clamp(5px,.8vw,10px)}
.tstep{border-radius:999px; border:3px solid var(--rule-soft); padding:3px clamp(10px,1.2vw,18px); font-weight:700;
  font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,15.5px); color:var(--ink-faint); background:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display)}
.tstep.now{border-color:var(--bleu); color:var(--bleu)}
.tstep.done{border-color:var(--vert); color:var(--vert)}

/* ---------- le comptage final des doigts ---------- */
#view-deco.counting .deco-main, #view-deco.counting .house, #view-deco.counting .deco-turn{display:none}
#view-deco.counting{justify-content:center; gap:clamp(10px,2.4vh,28px)}
#view-deco.counting .hs{height:clamp(120px,30vh,330px)}
#view-deco.counting .handcard b{display:none}
.eqrow{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,24px); flex-wrap:wrap}
.eqcard{min-width:1.5em; padding:.02em .22em; text-align:center; border:5px solid var(--c,var(--ink)); border-radius:20px; background:#fff;
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(30px,5.6vw,80px); line-height:1.25; color:var(--c,var(--ink));
  box-shadow:var(--lift); opacity:0; transform:scale(.4); transition:opacity .3s, transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
.eqcard.on{opacity:1; transform:none}
.eqrow .arr, .eqrow .plus{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(24px,4.4vw,64px); color:var(--ink-faint);
  opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s}
.eqrow .arr.on, .eqrow .plus.on{opacity:1}
.eqcard.target{--c:var(--ink); background:#FFF6DC; border-color:var(--gold)}
.fg.count{stroke:#E9A51C; stroke-width:7px}
.glyphsvg{width:auto; height:100%; max-height:min(42vh,420px); max-width:100%; overflow:visible}
.trace{fill:none; stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.ghost{fill:none; stroke:var(--rule-soft); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.ang{fill:none; stroke:var(--rule); stroke-width:9; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
  transition:stroke .5s ease, stroke-width .5s ease, opacity .5s ease}
.ang.dark{stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:12}
.ang.fade{opacity:.16; stroke:var(--ink)}
.ptg{transition:transform .95s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1)}
.pt{fill:var(--red); transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; animation:popin .32s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
.ptn{fill:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:9px; text-anchor:middle; dominant-baseline:central; pointer-events:none}
.startn{fill:var(--bleu)}
.startt{fill:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:10px; text-anchor:middle; dominant-baseline:central}
.verdict{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; text-align:center; font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,28px)}
.verdict b{color:var(--red)}

/* ---------- pied : frise + action ---------- */
.foot{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:clamp(8px,1.5vw,18px); padding-bottom:calc(clamp(8px,1.4vh,16px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); flex-wrap:wrap}
.frise{display:flex; gap:clamp(4px,.7vw,9px); flex:1; min-width:0}
.fcell{flex:1; min-width:0; background:var(--card); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(22,40,79,.07);
  padding:clamp(4px,.8vh,9px) 2px 3px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2px; opacity:.42; transition:opacity .2s, transform .14s}
.fcell.on{opacity:1; box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.fcell:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.fcell svg{width:100%; max-width:46px; height:auto}
.fcell .w{font-size:clamp(8px,.95vw,11.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:600}
.fcell.target{outline:3px solid var(--bleu); outline-offset:2px}
.actions{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center}
.btn{background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; padding:clamp(10px,1.7vh,16px) clamp(18px,2.6vw,34px);
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(14px,1.9vmin,22px); box-shadow:var(--lift); transition:transform .12s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.btn.go{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2F74DF,#2358B4)}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card); color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:var(--font-ui); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(11.5px,1.4vmin,14px); padding:10px 16px}

/* ---------- panneau maitresse ---------- */
.panel{position:fixed; top:0; right:0; height:100%; width:min(430px,100%); background:var(--card); box-shadow:-20px 0 50px -30px rgba(22,40,79,.6);
  z-index:40; overflow-y:auto; padding:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 18px calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px}
.panel h2{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; margin:0; font-size:21px}
.panel section{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px}
.panel h4{margin:0; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint)}
.row{display:flex; gap:7px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center}
.tog{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; min-width:40px; padding:8px 4px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:17px; color:var(--ink-soft); background:#fff; flex:1}
.tog.on{background:var(--bleu); border-color:var(--bleu); color:#fff}
.mini{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.mini.on{background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); color:#fff}
.studrow{display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center}
.studrow input[type=text]{flex:1; min-width:0; border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; padding:9px 11px; font:inherit; font-weight:600; background:#fff; color:var(--ink)}
.swatches{display:flex; gap:4px}
.sw{width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); border:3px solid #fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--rule-soft)}
.sw.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ink)}
.kill{color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:19px; padding:0 4px}
.lab{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink)}
.lab input{width:19px; height:19px; accent-color:var(--bleu)}
select{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; padding:9px 11px; font:inherit; font-weight:600; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); width:100%}

Ensuite vient la décomposition du même nombre, et c'est <b>celui qui avait trouvé le premier qui recommence</b>.<br><br>

Chaque élève doit trouver une décomposition <b>différente</b> de celles déjà posées ; sinon l'écran refuse. Quand elle est juste, on vérifie en comptant les doigts un par un, les deux cases s'affichent — <b>3</b> + <b>4</b> — puis la flèche vers le nombre de départ : → 7. Quand tout le monde en a trouvé une, on passe au nombre suivant.<br><br>

function makePad(id, onPoint){
  const cv = document.getElementById(id);
  if(!cv) return {clear(){}, setColor(){}, fit(){}, empty(){return true;}};
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  let strokes = [], cur = null, color = "#16284F";
  const lw = () => Math.max(4, cv.width * 0.017);
  function fit(){
    const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(!r.width || !r.height) return;
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2.5);
    const w = Math.round(r.width * dpr), h = Math.round(r.height * dpr);
    if(w === cv.width && h === cv.height) return;
    cv.width = w; cv.height = h; redraw();
  }
  function redraw(){
    ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
    ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    strokes.forEach(st => {
      ctx.strokeStyle = st.color; ctx.fillStyle = st.color; ctx.lineWidth = lw();
      if(st.pts.length < 2){
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(st.pts[0].x*cv.width, st.pts[0].y*cv.height, lw()/2, 0, 6.3); ctx.fill(); return;
      }
      ctx.beginPath();
      st.pts.forEach((q, i) => { const x = q.x*cv.width, y = q.y*cv.height; if(i) ctx.lineTo(x,y); else ctx.moveTo(x,y); });
      ctx.stroke();
    });
  }
  function seg(st){
    const k = st.pts.length; if(k < 2) return;
    ctx.strokeStyle = st.color; ctx.lineWidth = lw(); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    const a = st.pts[k-2], b = st.pts[k-1];
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x*cv.width, a.y*cv.height); ctx.lineTo(b.x*cv.width, b.y*cv.height); ctx.stroke();
  }
  function at(e){ const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width, y:(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height}; }
  cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
    e.preventDefault(); try{ cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); }catch(err){}
    const q = at(e);
    cur = {color:color, pts:[q]}; strokes.push(cur); redraw();
    if(onPoint) onPoint(q.x, q.y);
  });
  cv.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if(!cur) return; e.preventDefault();
    const q = at(e); cur.pts.push(q); seg(cur);
    if(onPoint) onPoint(q.x, q.y);
  });
  const stop = () => { cur = null; };
  cv.addEventListener("pointerup", stop);
  cv.addEventListener("pointercancel", stop);
  cv.addEventListener("pointerleave", stop);
  try{ new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(cv); }catch(e){}
  return {
    clear(){ strokes = []; redraw(); },
    setColor(c){ color = c; },
    fit, empty(){ return !strokes.length; }
  };
}

function posTas(n){

  while(left > 0 && groups.length < maxG){
    const rest = maxG - groups.length - 1;
    const hi = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, left - rest));
    const g = groups.length === maxG - 1 ? left : 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*hi);
    groups.push(g); left -= g;
  }
  if(left > 0) groups[groups.length-1] += left;
  const cx = groups.length === 2 ? [32, 68] : [24, 50, 76];
  const out = [];
  groups.forEach((g, i) => {

function posDisperse(n){

function handSVGC(cols, mirror, tagStart){
  const F = [{x:28,h:64},{x:46,h:74},{x:64,h:66},{x:82,h:52}], SKIN = "#FFD9B8";
  let tag = (typeof tagStart === "number") ? tagStart : null;
  const attr = () => (tag === null ? "" : ' class="fg" data-f="' + (tag++) + '"');
  let s = '<svg viewBox="-28 -4 138 156" aria-hidden="true"' + (mirror ? ' style="transform:scaleX(-1)"' : '') + '>';
  s += '<g stroke="#DFA87A" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round">';
  s += cols[0]
    ? '<rect' + attr() + ' x="-24" y="70" width="24" height="60" rx="12" transform="rotate(32 -12 128)" fill="'+cols[0]+'"/>'
    : '<rect x="6" y="96" width="50" height="22" rx="11" fill="'+SKIN+'"/>';
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const f = F[i], c = cols[i+1], h = c ? f.h : 26;
    s += '<rect' + (c ? attr() : "") + ' x="'+f.x+'" y="'+(96-h)+'" width="16" height="'+(h+16)+'" rx="8" fill="'+(c||SKIN)+'"/>';
  }

  return s;
}
function handsSVG(count, col, tagStart){
  const hands = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / 5));
  let out = "", tag = (typeof tagStart === "number") ? tagStart : null;
  for(let h=0; h<hands; h++){
    const up = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, count - h*5));
    const cols = [];
    for(let i=0;i<up;i++) cols.push(col);
    while(cols.length < 5) cols.push(null);
    out += handSVGC(cols, h % 2 === 1, tag === null ? undefined : tag);
    if(tag !== null) tag += up;
  }
  return out;
}

}

        const t = svgEl("text", {class:"startt", x:x, y:y}); t.textContent = i + 1; g.appendChild(t);
        $("#r-start").appendChild(g);
        tone(700 + i*120, 0.2, "triangle", 0.12);
      }, i * 640));
      speak("On trace le " + WORDS[n] + " comme ça.");
    }, 950);
    buttons("À toi d'écrire →", nextStep, "", null);
    return;
  }
  startPractice();
}

/* ---------------- l'entrainement d'ecriture : trois temps, ordre aleatoire ---------------- */
function shuffle(arr){
  const a = arr.slice();
  for(let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
  }
  return a;
}
let T = null;

function fitTrace(){
  const w = $("#tracewrap"), b = $("#tracebox");
  if(!w || !b || !w.clientHeight) return;
  const ratio = 128 / 132;
  const bh = Math.min(w.clientHeight, w.clientWidth / ratio);
  b.style.width = (bh * ratio) + "px"; b.style.height = bh + "px";
}
try{ new ResizeObserver(fitTrace).observe(document.getElementById("tracewrap")); }catch(e){}

function startPractice(){
  clearTimers();
  if(!R.order.length) R.order = newOrderFrom(picked || S.students[0]);
  R.writeOrder = shuffle(S.students);
  R.writeIdx = 0;
  practiceTurn();
}
function practiceTurn(){
  clearTimers();
  const who = R.writeOrder[R.writeIdx];
  if(!who){ afterWriting(); return; }
  phase = "trace";
  T = {stage:1, who:who};
  show(["trace"]);
  tracePad.setColor(COLORS[who.color] || "#16284F");
  renderTraceTurn();
  setStage(1);
}
function renderTraceTurn(){
  const t = $("#trace-turn"); t.innerHTML = "";
  R.writeOrder.forEach((st, i) => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "tpill" + (i === R.writeIdx ? " now" : "") + (i < R.writeIdx ? " done" : "");
    b.style.setProperty("--c", COLORS[st.color] || COLORS.bleu);
    b.innerHTML = '<span class="av">' + st.name.slice(0,1).toUpperCase() + '</span>' + st.name + (i < R.writeIdx ? " ✓" : "");
    b.onclick = () => { R.writeIdx = i; practiceTurn(); };
    t.appendChild(b);
  });
}
function renderTSteps(){
  const names = ["1 · relier les points", "2 · sur le chiffre", "3 · tout seul"];
  $("#tsteps").innerHTML = names.map((nm, i) =>
    '<span class="tstep' + (i + 1 === T.stage ? " now" : (i + 1 < T.stage ? " done" : "")) + '">' + nm + (i + 1 < T.stage ? " ✓" : "") + '</span>'
  ).join("");
}
function revealChain(group, lens, target){
  let cum = 0;
  Array.from(group.children).forEach((pa, i) => {
    const L = lens[i];
    const show = Math.max(0, Math.min(L, target - cum));
    pa.style.strokeDashoffset = L - show;
    cum += L;
  });
}
function traceShake(){
  const bx = $("#tracebox");
  bx.classList.remove("nope"); void bx.offsetWidth; bx.classList.add("nope");
  tone(260, 0.14, "sine", 0.1);
}
function setStage(stage){
  clearTimers();
  T.stage = stage; T.done = false; T.lastWrong = 0;
  const n = R.n, who = T.who, c = COLORS[who.color] || "#16284F";
  tracePad.clear();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { fitTrace(); });
  $("#tracebox").classList.remove("win");
  $("#tsvg").style.setProperty("--tc", c);
  $("#t-dots").innerHTML = ""; $("#t-ghost").innerHTML = ""; $("#t-ink").innerHTML = ""; $("#t-start").innerHTML = "";
  renderTSteps();
  if(stage === 1){
    /* relier les points dans l'ordre : le chiffre apparaît grâce au tracé */
    const g = $("#t-ink");
    g.innerHTML = (ANG[n] ? ANG[n].s : []).map(d => '<path class="tink" d="' + d + '"/>').join("");
    const paths = Array.from(g.children);
    T.lens = paths.map(pa => pa.getTotalLength());
    T.total = T.lens.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0);
    paths.forEach((pa, i) => {
      pa.style.strokeDasharray = T.lens[i];
      pa.style.strokeDashoffset = T.lens[i];
      pa.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset .3s ease";
    });
    const dots = ANG[n] ? ANG[n].d : [];
    T.dotPos = dots.map(d => {
      let best = 0, bd = 1e9, cum = 0;
      paths.forEach((pa, i) => {
        for(let k = 0; k <= T.lens[i]; k += 2){
          const q = pa.getPointAtLength(k);
          const dist = Math.hypot(q.x - d[0], q.y - d[1]);
          if(dist < bd){ bd = dist; best = cum + k; }
        }
        cum += T.lens[i];
      });
      return best;
    });
    T.next = 0;
    T.dots = dots.map((d, i) => ({x:d[0], y:d[1], i:i}));
    T.dots.forEach(d => {
      const gr = svgEl("g", {class:"tdot" + (d.i === 0 ? " next" : "")});
      gr.dataset.i = d.i;
      gr.appendChild(svgEl("circle", {r:9, cx:d.x, cy:d.y}));
      const tx = svgEl("text", {x:d.x, y:d.y}); tx.textContent = d.i + 1;
      gr.appendChild(tx);
      $("#t-dots").appendChild(gr);
    });
    say('<span style="color:' + c + '">' + who.name + '</span> relie les points dans l’ordre', "Le chiffre va apparaître !");
    speak(who.name + " ! Relie les points dans l'ordre, en comptant : le chiffre va apparaître.");
    buttons("", null, "Étape suivante →", () => setStage(2));
  } else if(stage === 2){
    /* repasser sur le chiffre dans le sens du tracé, depuis le départ */
    $("#t-ghost").innerHTML = (DIGITS[n] ? DIGITS[n].p : []).map(d => '<path class="tghost" d="' + d + '"/>').join("");
    $("#t-ink").innerHTML = (DIGITS[n] ? DIGITS[n].p : []).map(d => '<path class="tink2" d="' + d + '"/>').join("");
    const over = Array.from($("#t-ink").children);
    T.lens = over.map(pa => pa.getTotalLength());
    over.forEach((pa, i) => {
      pa.style.strokeDasharray = T.lens[i];
      pa.style.strokeDashoffset = T.lens[i];
      pa.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset .2s linear";
    });
    T.checks = []; T.prog = 0;
    let cum = 0;
    Array.from($("#t-ghost").children).forEach(pa => {
      const L = pa.getTotalLength();
      for(let k = 0; k <= L; k += 7){
        const pt = pa.getPointAtLength(k);
        T.checks.push({x:pt.x, y:pt.y, len:cum + k});
      }
      cum += L;
    });
    const marks = [];
    Array.from($("#t-ghost").children).forEach((pa, i) => {
      const p0 = pa.getPointAtLength(0);
      let x = p0.x, y = p0.y;
      marks.forEach(m => { if(Math.hypot(m.x - x, m.y - y) < 16){ x += 20; y -= 15; } });
      marks.push({x:x, y:y});
      const gg = svgEl("g", {});
      gg.appendChild(svgEl("circle", {class:"startn", cx:x, cy:y, r:9}));
      const tt = svgEl("text", {class:"startt", x:x, y:y}); tt.textContent = i + 1;
      gg.appendChild(tt);
      $("#t-start").appendChild(gg);
    });
    $("#t-dots").appendChild(svgEl("circle", {id:"tfront", class:"tfront", r:7, cx:T.checks[0].x, cy:T.checks[0].y}));
    say('<span style="color:' + c + '">' + who.name + '</span> repasse sur le chiffre', "Pars du rond qui clignote et suis le chemin.");
    speak("Maintenant, repasse sur le " + WORDS[n] + " : pars du rond qui clignote et suis le chemin, sans sauter.");
    buttons("", null, "Étape suivante →", () => setStage(3));
  } else {
    say('<span style="color:' + c + '">' + who.name + '</span>, tout seul !', "Écris le " + n + " sans modèle.");
    speak("À toi tout seul : écris " + WORDS[n] + ".");
    const last = R.writeIdx >= R.writeOrder.length - 1;
    buttons("⭐ C'est réussi" + (last ? (S.mode === "plein" ? " — on décompose →" : " — on avance →") : " — au suivant →"), () => {
      T.who.stars++; save(); renderChips(T.who.id); sfxWin(); speak("Bravo " + T.who.name + " !");
      R.writeIdx++; practiceTurn();
    }, "Passer", () => { R.writeIdx++; practiceTurn(); });
  }
}
function traceHit(nx, ny){
  if(phase !== "trace" || !T || T.done) return;
  const vx = -14 + nx * 128, vy = -12 + ny * 132;
  if(T.stage === 1 && T.dots){
    const exp = T.dots[T.next];
    if(exp && Math.hypot(exp.x - vx, exp.y - vy) < 13){
      const el = document.querySelector('.tdot[data-i="' + exp.i + '"]');
      if(el){ el.classList.remove("next"); el.classList.add("lit"); }
      T.next++;
      revealChain($("#t-ink"), T.lens, T.next >= T.dots.length ? T.total : T.dotPos[T.next - 1]);
      tone(500 + T.next * 70, 0.18, "triangle", 0.15);
      speak(WORDS[T.next]);
      const nxt = document.querySelector('.tdot[data-i="' + T.next + '"]');
      if(nxt) nxt.classList.add("next");
      if(T.next >= T.dots.length){
        T.done = true;
        $("#tracebox").classList.add("win");
        sfxWin();
        later(() => speak("Et voilà le " + WORDS[R.n] + " ! Bravo !"), 500);
        later(() => setStage(2), 2000);
      }
    } else if(Date.now() - T.lastWrong > 900){
      const wrong = T.dots.some((d, k) => k > T.next && Math.hypot(d.x - vx, d.y - vy) < 13);
      if(wrong){ T.lastWrong = Date.now(); traceShake(); }
    }
  } else if(T.stage === 2 && T.checks && T.checks.length){
    let j = -1;
    for(let k = T.prog; k < Math.min(T.prog + 5, T.checks.length); k++){
      if(Math.hypot(T.checks[k].x - vx, T.checks[k].y - vy) < 9.5) j = k;
    }
    if(j < 0) return;
    T.prog = j + 1;
    revealChain($("#t-ink"), T.lens, T.checks[T.prog - 1].len);
    const fr = document.getElementById("tfront");
    if(T.prog >= T.checks.length){
      T.done = true;
      if(fr) fr.remove();
      $("#tracebox").classList.add("win");
      sfxWin(); speak("Bravo !");
      later(() => setStage(3), 1500);
    } else if(fr){
      fr.setAttribute("cx", T.checks[T.prog].x);
      fr.setAttribute("cy", T.checks[T.prog].y);
    }
  }
}

  startDeco();
}

      const k = document.createElement("button");

      k.onclick = () => { S.students = S.students.filter(x => x !== st); save(); renderPanel(); renderChips(); };
      row.appendChild(k);
    }
    box.appendChild(row);
  });
}

    const st = S.students["abcdef".indexOf(k)];
    if(st) goBoard(st);
    return;
  }
  if(k === "r" && R && phase !== "deco" && phase !== "decowin"){ recount(() => askPhase()); }
});
